description: SRUP - Gasodutos e Oleodutos is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direção-Geral do Território. Servidão e Restriction de Utilidade Pública (SRUP) - Gasodutos e Oleodutos, in force in mainland Portugal. The Pipelines and Oil Pipelines constitute a servitude and restriction of public utility, being inserted in the scope of infrastructure. Coverage: Direção-Geral do Território. The portal shows the English title as "SRUP - Pipelines and Oil Pipelines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direção-Geral do Território. Its keywords include cartografia-oficial, srup, em-vigor, snig-dgterritorio-gov-pt, gasodutos-e-oleodutos, nacional. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
